links.outcome: Proportion of clinicians reporting institutional AI guidance available
links.effect: Institutional guidance was rare (n = 7, 11%); 68% supported formal training and 86% supported regulation.
links.quote: Institutional guidance was rare (n = 7, 11%), though most respondents supported formal training (n = 43, 68%) and regulation (n = 54, 86%).

links.outcome: Current clinician use of AI for clinical or administrative work without official approval
links.effect: 52% (n = 33) had used AI for clinical or administrative work; 70% (n = 44) would use it if officially approved; institutional guidance reported by only 11%.
links.quote: While only 52% (n = 33) had used AI for clinical or administrative work, 70% (n = 44) indicated they would do so if officially approved.

screen.reason: Cross-sectional survey of healthcare professionals assessing perceptions, current use, safety/ethics concerns, and readiness for AI in medical documentation.
